decisions.decision: Prefer N1 2022-2023 joint mean/SD schedule-normalized baseline; N13 published 2026 uses 2019-2022 reducer cohort and no replacement population mean.
Prefer 2023 US resident stratum; retain older attending prescribing-hour rate only as a distinct historical endpoint.
Newest located US direct pump-activity duration evidence; not a whole-ward hourly or adjusted error-risk replacement.
Use modern signed lateness and supply-omission subtypes; retain old general-ward relevant-omission and barcode before/after contrasts because endpoint/denominator differs.
Recent Australian clinical pharmacists have 34 interruptions/day; old dispensing-staff duration moments remain distinct, not overwritten.
Replace ED time-allocation comparator with newer 2026 paper but label both as older cohorts; N10 observes 2019.
2021/2022 source-equivalent order/alert tasks preferred; old refill UI seconds retained. 2026 operational refill turnaround is not active UI time. Upload dates do not date core cohorts.

National 2022 waiting/after-hours and 2017-2024 boarding supplement older hourly arrivals; Karpman et al. 2021 DOI 10.5055/jem.0569 PMID 33954967 uses 2009-2019 observations and cannot supply post-pandemic hourly bins.
Newer follow-up, per-patient handoff and recovery-performance studies do not identify old paired acknowledgment, whole-transition start/end or resumption/ordinary-action interval estimands.
